about: Amendments that carry out docs/decisions/2026-11-01-polyatomic-ion-two-words.md, [USER]'s correction of 2026-11-01. Applied on top of amendments-2026-10-29.json and amendments-2026-10-30.json (give all three to tools/ai-review/compile-ruling-set.js, oldest first). One retarget: polyatomic ion becomes the two-word fjölatóma jón, the form Íðorðabankinn's chemistry concept already lists and the machine translation already writes; the withdrawn one-word target survives as a competitor. Hand-written input: its sha256 is recorded in the compiled artifact, so any edit must be followed by a recompile.

amendments.decision: polyatomic ion is fjölatóma jón, two words; it supersedes the 2026-10-29 record's polyatomic ion row (fjölatómajón)
